name: 77598 · Webster, TX
findings: ZIP 77598 (Webster) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77598 (Webster) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77598 (Webster) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
